text:
ana: quick q — PR https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/492 adds validation for /v1/generate params. Do we want schema-level failures to be 400 or 422? Also, should SDKs retry on 5xx/503 but never on 4xx? I'm drafting a tiny compat note for the SDKs and want to be consistent.

kevin: short answer: status code semantics should be strict — 4xx = client problem (dont retry), 5xx = server/transient (retry with backoff). Practically: missing required field or wrong JSON type -> 400. Semantic checks (prompt too long, profanity/policy triggered on input) -> 422. 429 for rate limits. This mirrors what we used in the v1 contract last year. See spec section: https://go/redwood-api-spec#error-codes (WIP).

mira: small nuance re: streaming: if the stream starts emitting tokens and then we detect a policy block mid-generation, do we end the stream with a 4xx/422 or shove a 5xx? Clients expect a deterministic termination pattern.

kevin: good point. My take: keep HTTP status aligned with cause. If it's input-triggered (policy/validation) -> 422 midstream (we send an error chunk and close). If it's runtime failure (OOM, node crash) -> 5xx and close. We should define an "error chunk" format so SDKs can handle it uniformly.

sam: +1 to a defined envelope. Suggest error envelope fields: code, message, type, retryable, maybe retry_after for 429/503. Example we could add to docs:```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "input_too_long",
    "message": "input tokens 120k exceeds max 64k",
    "type": "validation_error",
    "retryable": false
  }
}
```

jordan: caution: we can't rely solely on a "retryable" flag in body for older SDKs — they often short-circuit on status != 200 and won't inspect payload. So status code must remain authoritative. The body flag is just a helpful hint for new SDKs.

kevin: agreed. Status code = source of truth. Body flags are additive. Also: for 429/503 we should include a retry_after secs field and set Retry-After header.

deploy-bot: staging deploy for PR 492 succeeded. e2e tests passed (8/8).

ana: (typo fix) — sorry meant "ana" earlier.

ana: following up — i'll update PR to use 400 for schema/type errors, 422 for semantic validation (length, policy), 429 for rate limiting, and 5xx for infra faults. I'll add the error-envelope example Sam pasted and include a short streaming termination paragraph. CC @sam @mira to review SDK doc bit.

mira: :thumbsup: that plan sounds good. One ask: mention that streaming clients should treat the final error chunk as terminal even if status is 200 in some proxies — include both header and body signals.

kevin: also add an example of idempotency conflict -> 409 (non-retryable) so clients can handle it specially.

ana: noted. i'll push the updates tonight and tag reviewers. Thanks all.

mira: thanks!
